Paediatric nephrology deals with diseases of the kidneys, urinary tract, bladder and urethra in children from birth to 18 years. Paediatric neurology diagnoses and treats disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles in children from birth to 18 years. Early assessment can be important for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, supported by tests such as MRI and EEG where needed. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, investigations and follow-up at our partner hospital.

Paediatric oncology focuses on the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of cancers in children and adolescents up to the age of 18, including solid tumours, lymphomas and leukaemias. Childhood cancers behave differently from adult cancers and call for care designed around young patients and their families. MedLuxLife coordinates assessments and treatment at our partner hospital, helping families with records, appointments, travel and communication throughout the course of care.

MedLuxLife arranges consultations and follow-up at our partner hospital and supports families throughout their stay.
